name: Embers
desc: A rising stream of embers cools from white-hot to deep red as it climbs, wiggling with heat and scattering sideways on bass gusts.

hue.doc: ember base hue (24=fire orange; used as heat base in thermal)

style.doc: ember=additive glowing dots cooling orange->red / thermal=false-color heat ramp (abstract) / spark=hot core + vertical trail / sumi=grey ash flecks (BLEND, monochrome) / ascii=dot-matrix heat glyphs (abstract)
